svg.aria-label: About. Now: Visão, a cognitive architecture with memory. At work: APIs, webhooks into ERPs and LLM automations. Goal: Systems that run unsupervised, from the Netherlands. Beyond code: Late nights, rain, The Neighbourhood on repeat.
